title: The First Empire
text: The oldest known civilization, called the Ancients. It built the Skeletons as workers, raised machines and ruins that no one alive can rebuild, and fell long before any living human was born. Its ancient labs, still guarded by Security Spiders, hold most of the technology the world has lost.

title: The War of Behemoths
text: During the First Empire the Ancients fought a war with an enemy whose name is lost. They built the Behemoths, Skeleton war machines of enormous size, to win it. The rusted bodies of Behemoths still lie half-buried in the land.

title: Obedience
text: Afraid of the Behemoths they had made, the Ancients ordered them to walk into a pit and be sealed away. The Skeletons carried out the order. Old Skeletons remember it as Obedience, and the word still carries great weight among them.

title: Stobe the Behemoth
text: Stobe was the last of the Behemoths. The lands of Stobe's Gamble and Stobe's Garden carry its name. Some scholars at World's End believe that the hero Chitrin, who ended the Chaos Age in legend, was Stobe.

title: The Chaos Age
text: After the First Empire came an age of disasters, plagues, and Skeleton revolt that nearly ended humanity. Few records survive it. Legend says that a being named Chitrin brought the calamities to an end.

title: The Second Empire
text: After the Chaos Age, Cat-Lon and other Skeletons founded an empire to protect and rebuild what was left of humanity. It brought peace for a time, but it grew into a tyranny of child prisons, purges, and famine. It fell to rebellion from without and betrayal from within, and Cat-Lon withdrew to the Ashlands with his loyal Skeletons.

title: The Hydraulic Knights
text: The elite Skeleton army of the Second Empire, led by General Jang. They drove the Cannibal tribes back, and the Cannibals still tell of a Skeleton warrior they could not eat or stop.

title: The Okranite Rebellion
text: The humans of the northwest rose against the failing Second Empire under the banner of Okran. The Holy Nation was born from this rebellion and remembers it as a holy liberation from the machines.

title: The Red Rebellion
text: A rebellion in the United Cities brought down the previous emperor. Emperor Tengu took the throne afterward, together with the nobles who rule beside him today.

title: The Holy Nation and the Shek
text: The Holy Nation and the Shek Kingdom have fought along their shared border for longer than anyone remembers. The Holy Nation calls the Shek abominations; the Shek see the Holy Nation as worthy enemies for a warrior's death. Esata seeks peace, but neither side trusts the other.

title: The Shek Extinction Crisis
text: The Shek are dying out. Generations of glorious deaths in battle have killed more of them than are born. Esata the Stone Golem wants her people to make peace and raise children, while Kral's Chosen, the Band of Bones, and the Berserkers would rather keep the old way.

title: The Slave Economy
text: Slavery is legal in the United Cities, and debt or poverty can earn a person a collar. The Slave Traders supply labor to the farms and mines, the Traders Guild profits from it, and Manhunters return those who escape. The Anti-Slavers fight the trade by burning farms and freeing slaves.

title: The Hive Queens
text: Every Hive centers on its Queen, whose scent binds the drones to her. The Western Hive and the Southern Hive each serve a living Queen. The Fogmen are what became of a Hive that lost its Queen.

title: Okran and Narko
text: The Holy Nation worships Okran, the god of light, and fears Narko, the goddess of darkness, whom it blames for Skeletons, Shek, Hivers, and disobedient women. The Flotsam Ninjas hold a different view, in which light and darkness are both part of the world.

title: The Fleshless Doctrine
text: The belief of the Skin Bandits that every living being is a Skeleton under its flesh, and that peeling away the flesh sets the true self free.

title: Ancient Technology
text: The machines of the Ancients still work in the ruins, but no one knows how to make them. AI cores and ancient science books are the best clues to that lost knowledge, and the Tech Hunters, the Great Library at Black Scratch, and the scholars of World's End trade in them.

title: Kenshi is a Moon
text: A giant planet fills part of the sky, and several moons cross it. Scholars of the old records hold that Kenshi itself is a moon of that planet. The Preacher Cult worships the moons.
